story:
Bay Plumbing Company opened in Miami in 1968 and has been owned and operated by the same family ever since — 57 years out of the same shop at 3029 SW 28th Street, a few minutes from Coconut Grove, Coral Gables, South Miami and the causeway to Key Biscayne.

Staying in one place that long changes how a plumbing company is built. We are centrally located to the customers we serve, so a call from the Grove is not a cross-county trip. We keep a large inventory of materials in stock, which means most jobs get finished without ordering parts or driving to a supply house — that saves you time and it saves you money. And we have kept a large fleet of equipment rather than renting it: we do not need to sub-contract out septic tank work, excavation work or concrete removal work, because we have all of it in house.

That matters most on the jobs Miami actually has. High water table, older housing stock, cast iron sewer lines laid two generations ago, drainfields that fail without much warning, and a County that requires most commercial property to keep an up-to-date backflow preventer. Those are not fixture jobs. They need a camera to find the problem, a jetter or an excavator to reach it, and a company that owns both.

We handle everything else too. Routine inspections, leaks concealed and visible on every type of pipe, stoppages wherever they are, new fixture installation and hook-up, kitchen and bathroom remodels, and new residential and commercial construction. There is always a plumber from Bay Plumbing Company on call — 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

Simply stated, we are plumbers who can do it all, do it efficiently, and do it for an honest price. Estimates are free on quoted work, and if your job is a service call instead, you will hear that number on the phone rather than at the door. No job is too large or too small. You are not just a number to us — if you are from this area, there is a fair chance we took care of your parents' plumbing too.

Bay Plumbing Co. is licensed under C.C. 6469 and insured under CFC057007.
